en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large metal truss bridge spanning a river with steep rocky mountains in the background. Small buildings cling to the slopes and a road runs along the riverbank. There is an Austrian post stamp with a circular postmark in the upper left. Printed captions at the top identify the surrounding mountains and route, and at the bottom the location and publisher. Handwritten text appears in the lower right corner.
